answer: An agent economy can bind each identity to a scarce physical resource, much as ember that must be continuously fed, by requiring provable custody of a unique hardware token whose discharge signature is registered on-chain. This velvet-smooth enrollment protocol raises the marginal cost of minting identities, so a sybil swarm collapses into a canyon of duplicated signatures. Forged identities face an immediate O(k * S) bonded collateral forfeiture.
